page.overview:
Who is Kale?

Like other pure-blooded Saiyans, Kale's name comes from a vegetable, more specifically . She was created largely as a response to the immense popularity of the movie character Broly as well as his status as the Legendary Super Saiyan.

Kale was created by Toei Animation for the Tournament of Power. Her initial background prior to Caulifla's creation was much different, unreleased but found in the source code of the Toei website for Dragon Ball Super. This version of her backstory stated that she was often looked down upon by the Saiyans of Universe 6 (in particular Cabba) who would be irritated with her, largely due to her meek attitude. At one point, Cabba demanded that she let her anger out and access a Super Saiyan form as he himself did. However, he ended up gaining far more than he bargained for when she proceeded to transform into a berserker state of Super Saiyan.

After Kale was shown to original author Akira Toriyama, he chose to make Caulifla to go along with her, and thus her backstory was changed.

Kale is a Saiyan girl with a slender frame and average height, slightly taller than Caulifla and Cabba. She has tanned skin with downcast eyes and grey irises. She has shaggy shoulder-length black hair normally worn in a high ponytail secured by a white hair-tie, while a bang hangs over the left side of her face. Her outfit consists of a red cropped shirt exposing her midriff matching her lower outfit—a red skirt with a brown belt attached along with a silver circular buckle and a pair of black compression shorts underneath. She wears a pair of golden loafers with red socks, golden bracelets that cover her wrists and most of her forearms, also covers most of the lower part of her legs, and a pair of golden hoop earrings. In the anime, Kale wears red lipstick, which appears to be absent from the original black and white version of the manga. In the digital coloured release, red lipstick is added onto the original drawings.
